tagline: Six-stage phaser and short-delay flanger in one
description: A modulation effect with two modes: a phaser built from six all-pass stages with feedback around them, and a flanger built from a modulated 5 to 15 ms delay with feedback. Use it to add sweeping movement to guitars, synths, drums or pads.

features.name: Phaser mode
features.description: Six first-order all-pass stages whose break frequency a sine LFO sweeps up to two octaves either side of Centre Freq (200 Hz to 2 kHz).

features.name: Flanger mode
features.description: An interpolated delay swept between 5 and 15 ms, with its output fed back into the delay line.

features.name: Feedback (-0.9 to 0.9)
features.description: Negative or positive feedback; in phaser mode the wet level is trimmed as feedback rises to hold back the resonant peaks.

features.name: Rate and Depth
features.description: LFO rate from 0.1 to 10 Hz; Depth sets the sweep width in both modes.

features.name: Mix
features.description: Crossfades between the dry and processed signal.
